'''Reid S''' is credited on 3 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s as the originator of the card idea ("Original concept by …").<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Set 9]] and [[Virtual Set 13]], sets dated 2018–2020 on this wiki. The credits on [[Admiral Ozzel (V)|•Admiral Ozzel (V)]], [[Apology Accepted (V)|•Apology Accepted (V)]] and [[Death Squadron Assignment|•Death Squadron Assignment]] are shared with [[Card Credits#Caleb F|Caleb F]], [[Card Credits#Jan W|Jan W]], [[Card Credits#John A|John A]], [[Card Credits#Jonathan W|Jonathan W]] and [[Tom H]].
